Quest name: Siberian musk (Chrono Quest - 3rd period, 18th Century)
Quest location: Stockholm Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r7 Ecological Research, r9 Biology, NOR(Nordic)
Pre-requisite discovery: Civet discovery (from "Cat that makes spices" quest) + Narwhal discovery (from "A unicorn's horn" quest)
Pre-requisite action (hidden): 2nd Eastern Region of Eurasia (Bering Sea) permit obtained
